settings.title: System settings
settings.subtitle: File storage, automatic invoice reading and email. Saved in the database; no server restart needed.
settings.precedence: A value saved here is used instead of the server's environment variable. Empty fields fall back to the environment variable, if any. Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again.

storage.title: File storage
storage.hint: Where invoice files and company logos are kept permanently. Switching does not move files already saved, so existing invoices stay in the previous location. Local disk files are lost if the server's disk is not persistent (for example a hosting platform without a volume) and must be backed up.

ocr.title: Automatic invoice reading
ocr.hint: Lets the app read invoice details from the uploaded file. Without a key, agents type the details by hand.

email.title: Email notifications
email.hint: Sends review and decision emails. Without a key, no emails are sent.

general.title: General
general.hint: Used for the links inside emails.

help.S3_ENDPOINT: For example https://oss-me-central-1.aliyuncs.com (use your region's endpoint).
help.S3_REGION: Leave empty unless your provider requires one.
help.S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: Needs read, write and delete on the bucket.
help.S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: Turn on for MinIO and some other services if uploads fail.
help.EMAIL_FROM: For example noreply@yourdomain.com. The domain must be verified in Resend.
help.APP_URL: For example https://petty.yourcompany.com, without a trailing slash.
help.STORAGE_MODE: Choose one. The S3 fields below apply only to S3 bucket; the folder path applies only to Local disk.
help.STORAGE_LOCAL_PATH: Used only for Local disk. Absolute path the app can write to, for example /var/lib/akcc/files. Empty uses the app's own storage folder.

test.title: Test file storage
test.hint: Saves the settings above first, then press the button to write and delete a small test file.

info.storageOk: Storage works: a test file was written and deleted.

errors.unauthorized: Only a System Administrator can change settings.
errors.badUrl: A URL must start with http:// or https://.
errors.noAuthSecret: The server has no AUTH_SECRET, so keys cannot be stored securely. Set AUTH_SECRET in the server environment first.
errors.storageMissing: Storage is not fully configured: endpoint, bucket, access key and secret are all required.
errors.storageFailed: The storage test failed. Check the endpoint, bucket and keys (path-style may help). Error type:
